subject: Vendr portal: dual-account evidence reconciliation and API rotation
messages:
From: Claire Mendez <claire@vendr.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Vendr Support <support@vendr.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr onboarding - evidence rotation + duplicate account for Bluecrest

Hi Hannah,

Quick note from Vendr — we started an automated scan of Bluecrest's profile and noticed two active Redwood-linked accounts in our system: one created during last year's procurement kickoff (procurement@bluecrest.com) and one created by your platform team (api-integ@bluecrest.com). That split is preventing our CAIQ/SIG ingest from attaching the full evidence set.

To get the portal sync back to green we need:
- confirmation of the canonical account (which email we should attach to Bluecrest records)
- a short manifest of the evidence items you can surface today (SOC2 report, KMS proof, S3 evidence pointers)
- confirmation whether you prefer us to accept a short-lived API credential (recommended) or manual evidence upload.

I'm attaching a small CAIQ fragment to show the mapping we expect. If you can confirm ownership and either grant a temporary API client (scoped to read-only) or drag the artifacts into the portal, we can finish the mapping and mark the submission complete.

Also looping in Bluecrest procurement in case they need to authorize account consolidation.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20 min call if helpful.

Claire
Claire Mendez
Customer Success, Vendr
attachments: 1) caiaq-fragment-sample.pdf (excerpt)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Claire Mendez <claire@vendr.com>, Vendr Support <support@vendr.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding - evidence rotation + duplicate account for Bluecrest

Thanks Claire — and thanks for the heads up.

We pulled the manifest and I'm attaching a CSV list of what we currently have staged. My quick answers:
- Canonical account: procurement@bluecrest.com (approved by legal/finance)
- Preferred method: temporary API client scoped to read-only for the evidence ingest (we'll rotate after the sync).
- Evidence: current SOC2 Type II (2027 audit), KMS key policy export, sample s3 paths for syslog delivery.

Ben — can you provision a short-lived client in Vendr with the least privilege (read artifacts only) and share creds in the secure vault? Aditya — please review the attached manifest and flag anything that's incomplete for the CAIQ mapping.

Claire — if you can create the client request in your portal and share the DocuSign link for the permission token, we'll approve it from procurement. A short 20 min screen-share tomorrow morning (10:00 PDT) would be ideal; otherwise we'll complete via email.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
attachments: 1) 20280412-vendr-evidence-manifest.csv
From: Claire Mendez <claire@vendr.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Vendr Support <support@vendr.com>
Cc: Bluecrest Procurement <procurement@bluecrest.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding - evidence rotation + duplicate account for Bluecrest

Thanks — that's perfect. I created a read-only API client (vendr-temp-client-8472) scoped to the Bluecrest record and generated a DocuSign permission envelope: https://app.docusign.com/manifest/2a4b6c.

Notes from our side:
- The CAIQ fragment you reviewed maps to the full SIG questionnaire; we'll import the fragment and return a differential report flagging missing artifacts.
- For KMS proof we accept either a public key fingerprint + rotation schedule PDF or a signed KMS policy export.
- We noticed a mismatch in your SOC2 PDF meta (audit date inside doc is 2026 rather than 2027). If that's a stale copy we need the updated doc.

I've attached the import plan (small checklist) and a direct portal link to the Bluecrest inventory: https://vendr.com/portal/Bluecrest/records/INV-8472.

If you approve the DocuSign envelope and confirm the canonical account, we'll perform the consolidation and re-run the CAIQ/SIG ingest.

—Claire

Looping up final steps and owners so nothing slips:

Action items (owners):
- Ben: provision vendr-temp-client-8472 in the Vendr portal, add client id to 1Password entry ‘vendr/bluecrest-temp’, mark expiration 72 hours after ingest (due: 2028-04-14 17:00 PDT).
- Aditya: validate SOC2 PDF (confirm the embedded metadata; replace if stale) and attach signed KMS export to the portal if available (due: 2028-04-14 12:00 PDT).
- Hannah: approve DocuSign envelope once Ben confirms credential rotation policy is set (I'll review and click through).

Claire — once we finish the steps above you can proceed with account consolidation. Please re-run the ingest and send the differential report back to this thread. If the ingest still flags missing artifacts we'll elevate to the ticketing queue and route to procurement/legal.

Thanks all — rapid turnaround on this will keep Bluecrest's procurement timeline on track.

Hannah
